boundary: APPRE is documentation architecture only; not validated AI, CDS, SaMD, or treatment optimizer.

rules.name: Safety override
rules.description: Any severe or serious adverse event triggers response-policy review before signal interpretation.

rules.name: One-variable documentation rule
rules.description: Candidate-input changes are documented one primary variable at a time where feasible.

rules.name: Baseline rule
rules.description: No candidate signal is interpreted without baseline window and variability estimate.

rules.name: Confounder rule
rules.description: Infection, medication change, hospitalization, fall, sleep collapse, travel, or caregiver disruption must be annotated before interpretation.

rules.name: Minimum completion rule
rules.description: Default primary interpretation requires >=70% Tier 1 daily and weekly completion unless protocol justifies alternate threshold.

rules.name: Exploratory signal rule
rules.description: >=0.3 SD directional change can flag review only; not validated responder criterion.

rules.name: Controlled-substance boundary
rules.description: APPRE records only as-administered observational exposure under separate lawful clinician-governed ethics-approved oversight if present.

rules.name: Burden ceiling
rules.description: Participant/caregiver burden triggers simplification before data ambition.

rules.name: Versioned response policy
rules.description: Every material update includes date, reason, window, reviewer, prior policy link.

rules.name: EEG confounder gate
rules.description: EEG sessions require sleep, caffeine, acute illness, medication, and artifact context before primary interpretation.

rules.name: Cycle boundary rule
rules.description: New cycles establish fresh baseline estimates; prior cycles are hypotheses, not established effects.

rules.name: Biomarker-EEG synchrony rule
rules.description: Matched EEG-biomarker analysis requires documented synchronization window.

rules.name: Repository release rule
rules.description: Public release increments version log and manifest; raw identifiable data excluded.
